info.title: LogiFlows API
info.description: LogiFlows Intelligent End-to-End Logistics Coordination and Delivery Management System API.

get.description: Returns 200 OK indicating the API process is alive
Verifies active database and Redis connections before accepting ingress traffic

post.description: Registers a new user, creates their primary tenant organization, and grants TENANT_ADMIN privileges
Authenticates user credentials and returns JWT access and refresh tokens
Validates refresh token, implements single-use rotation, detects token breaches, and returns a new access token
Revokes active refresh token and terminates authenticated session

get.description: Returns profile information and tenant memberships for the authenticated user
Returns current active organization details for the authenticated user
Returns current active company details for the authenticated user

get.description: Lists members and roles within the tenant organization

post.description: Adds a user to the tenant with a specified role. Requires TENANT_ADMIN role.
Creates a new logistics hub or branch with PostGIS geospatial coordinates. Requires TENANT_ADMIN.

get.description: Lists branches with optional PostGIS spatial radius filtering.

patch.description: Sets branch status to ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or SUSPENDED.

get.description: Lists all employees assigned to a specific branch hub.
Lists all fleet vehicles stationed at a specific branch hub.

post.description: Atomically provisions user account credentials, tenant membership, and employee operational profile.

201.description: Employee and login credentials created atomically

get.description: Returns operational profile, system role, and currently assigned vehicle for authenticated employee.

404.description: Employee profile not found for user

post.description: Registers staff, dispatchers, or delivery drivers with operational roles.

get.description: Lists verified, active drivers who are currently AVAILABLE for vehicle assignment.

get.summary: Get Employee Account & Login Credential Status
get.description: Returns whether the employee has a linked user account, active credentials, and system role.

patch.summary: Update Vehicle Operating and Availability Status

get.description: Lists historical and active vehicle assignments with optional filters.
Public, unauthenticated, sanitized parcel tracking for recipients and senders. Zero PII leaks.

get.description: Lists parcels with optional filters by status, branch, or search.

get.description: Retrieves comprehensive parcel details, chain-of-custody, and lifecycle event audit trail.
